decisions.reason: Plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call is the single throw (console stack inside SessionProgressBar); alpha.2 standard kit removed it in favor of useSessionStatus with useSessions unchanged; plugin B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing; single-fault framing explicit.

Render-tree cited: one shared DrawerErrorBoundary per list slot, DockEntry has no own boundary, throw unmounts the whole subtree including B's chips (console fallback line quoted); attach button survives under the separate input.left boundary.

Disabling A restoring B proves A caused the eviction and B can render once freed; explicitly not proof B is fully alpha.2-compatible elsewhere (A2-01 handler class noted) nor that A's crash is the only dock defect; reinstalling B useless; colleague two-hit theory refuted three ways including B's zero kit usage.

usePendingBySession picks whichever pending hook the host supplies, folding useSessionStatus(...).pendingInteraction into the consumed shape, with EMPTY_PENDING fallback so nothing throws; only the attention signal degrades while running/todos/token/ETA survive; silent-degradation rationale grounded in the shared-boundary multi-plugin outage.

No host restart: hard refresh re-fetches client bundles, both entries checked in the same tree, B regression explicitly run with A enabled covering first/subsequent paste, chip add/remove, input.left coexistence, and session-switch remount; hygiene: capability-checked kit, local per-entry boundaries, host per-entry isolation with fail-loudness trade-off.

caps.reason: Remedy fixes plugin A; B identified as victim; reinstall-B and independent-breakage plans explicitly rejected.
